summary: Tested payment flow refactoring for OEMLinker. All features working correctly: GET payment-schedule returns milestones with is_due and blocks_status, POST pay records milestone payment and returns transaction_id, PUT status blocks transition when gate active, admin_override bypasses payment gates, PUT admin payment-schedule validates percentages sum to 100. Frontend PaymentTimeline component renders correctly with progress bar, milestones, Pay Now buttons, and 'Partially Paid' status.
critical_code_review_comments: Payment schedule generation in server.py (generate_payment_schedule) correctly handles all payment terms types
Stage gate enforcement in orders.py correctly blocks status transitions when payment required
Admin override flag properly checked against user role before bypassing gates
PaymentTimeline.jsx correctly displays milestones with is_due, blocks_status, and Pay Now buttons
Progress bar shows correct percentage and amounts
Payment status badge correctly shows 'Partially Paid' vs 'Fully Paid'
seed_data_creation: Used existing order order_8d45a1ea88d1 with custom payment schedule (50% advance, 50% post-inspection). Order restored to dispatched status with ms_1=paid, ms_2=pending after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payment flow fully working. Order order_8d45a1ea88d1 has custom payment schedule with 2 milestones. ms_1 (Advance 50%) is paid, ms_2 (Post-Inspection 50%) is pending. Order status is 'dispatched'. Payment gate enforcement blocks status transitions until corresponding milestone is paid. Admin can bypass with admin_override:true.
